conditions.task: Open https://news.ycombinator.com, read the titles and comment counts of the top 5 stories, then open https://example.com and read its h1. Both arms found that example.com has no h1 and reported the page title.

arms.plain: Browser work in the main session.
arms.runner: Same task through the lean-browser-use skill and fresh runner, with the package installed project-scoped in a scratch project.

conditions.models: Main session claude-sonnet-5-5 in both arms; runner subagent claude-haiku-5-5.
conditions.tools: In-app Browser pane tools (mcp__Claude_Browser__*); lean-browser-use measure 0.1.0 over each arm transcripts.
conditions.method: One paired run. Per-step values are median input-context tokens; task values sum input-context tokens across browser steps, including main-session browser steps in the runner arm. Counts include input, cache creation and cache read tokens.
